site.name: Grand View Mine
site.location: Ridge between Salina and Sunshine, Boulder County
overview: Grand View Mine is a documented historic mine in Boulder County, located on the ridge between Salina and Sunshine.
Federal mineral records identify Grand View as a past producer associated with tungsten and gold, while historic USGS topographic mapping preserves the mine as a named locality.

timeline.text: Grand View was developed as part of Boulder County's hard-rock mining landscape and is recorded in the federal Mineral Resources Data System as a past-producing mine.
USGS topographic mapping continued to preserve Grand View Mine as a named mine locality in the Boulder quadrangle.

moreHistory: The Mineral Resources Data System record for Grand View lists tungsten and gold and places the mine on the ridge between Salina and Sunshine in Boulder County.

The MRDS position is documented as an estimated historic mine location derived from published mining references, so it is best treated as a mine-locality point rather than a surveyed surviving opening.
